name: StepRndFlt
description: Tempo-synced sample-and-hold LFO into a multimode resonant filter on AUDIO IN. Each step redraws a random cutoff offset around CUT. X = LFO depth, Y = resonance. TYPE selects LP12 / LP24 / BPF / HP12 / HP24. Hold the pad to engage; release returns to dry.

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: How far each S&H step moves cutoff around CUT (± octaves)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: CUT
params.detail: Center cutoff the S&H LFO modulates around

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: Filter mode: LP12, LP24, BPF, HP12, HP24

params.name: SLEW
params.detail: How quickly cutoff glides to each new random value
